title: Turkey larb bowl
summary: Turkey larb bowl is a thai dinner built around turkey breast mince and little gem lettuce, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Cook turkey breast mince for Turkey larb bowl in a lightly oiled pan until just done, and cook or warm lime juice alongside.
steps.tip: Keep the heat lively so a bowl supper still tastes cooked, not assembled from cold jars.

steps.instruction: Toss little gem lettuce with lemon or lime, herbs and a pinch of salt.
Pile the protein, salad and any grain into bowls.

Spoon over yoghurt, tahini or the pan juices and serve Turkey larb bowl straight away. Taste Turkey larb bowl before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.

image.alt: Turkey larb bowl served for dinner
